subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers sponsor a current-main replacement for this proven ordering bug, or wait for the contributor to rework the stale draft?
rationale: The user-visible bug is proven, but the open branch is draft, dirty, and needs owner-boundary decisions around canonical lane derivation and stalled-send handling before it can safely merge.

options.title: Sponsor replacement
options.body: Open or request a narrow current-main replacement that preserves the contributor's idea while using the current outbound queue and shared keyed-lane primitives.

options.title: Wait for contributor
options.body: Keep the draft open for the author to rebase and address the lane/key/stall findings on the original branch.

options.title: Close as too stale
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the proven ordering bug is not worth carrying forward from this draft.

recommendation.title: Sponsor replacement
recommendation.body: Open or request a narrow current-main replacement that preserves the contributor's idea while using the current outbound queue and shared keyed-lane primitives.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history owns the outbound delivery and shared keyed queue surfaces that the replacement would need to touch.
